label: Caravane
note: Camel's milk sets poorly with rennet; the FAO sent a scientist to teach the dairy a method (Wikipedia, 1992).

about.text: A soft, Brie-like cheese made from camel's milk in Mauritania by the dairy Tiviski, founded by Nancy Abeiderrahmane; sold mainly in Mauritania and Senegal.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
Brie-like camel milk cheese, brand of Tiviski (Mauritania); family moved from soft to bloomy
